Sharing quick findings from the meet:
- Host-level load: one replica showed sustained 92% GPU utilization; other replicas averaged 60%
- Kernel errors: elevated "KV cache miss -> memory-pressure" traces on replica-7; correlated exporter shows more GC pauses at 08:44 PDT
- Network: no obvious cloud-side packet loss; internal egress latency increased marginally (20–40ms)

Immediate actions taken (10:00 PDT):
- Scaled dedicated pool +2 replicas; traffic route updated to shift ~30% to new replicas
- Applied per-client token throttle (orthus-account-id) to cap peak TPS for mitigation
- Evicted LRU segments on affected replica and restarted the runtime process (replica-7) — reprobe ongoing

I'm attaching throughput_logs_20270612.zip (aggregated traces) and a short SLO chart. Will continue to watch error rates and p95.

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Li <evan.li@orthus.ai>
Cc: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Orthus production: interim status and next steps

Evan —

Quick customer-facing update from the war-room: we've identified memory-pressure related KV-cache misses on one replica that correlated with a brief GC pause at 08:44 PDT. Immediate mitigations we applied:
- spun up two extra replicas and shifted ~30% traffic away from the affected replica
- applied a soft token-rate cap for the Orthus account to smooth bursts
- evicted LRU cache segments and restarted the runtime on the impacted node

Impact now: error rate has fallen from ~6% to ~0.9% over the last 30 minutes; p95 latency improved to ~600ms. We're keeping the throttle in place for the next 60 minutes while we validate stability and run a targeted canary without the throttle. If stable, we'll remove the throttle and scale back the extra replicas.

Action for Orthus: if you can confirm whether any client-side retry burst patterns could explain the initial surge, that would help prevent recurrence. We'll follow up with a concise post-incident summary in the next 24 hours.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
